opportunities.name: GitHub candidate lead email
opportunities.description: Search a GitHub username, open the user's profile and top repo, then draft a lead email to hiring@example.com with role, followers, top repo stats and latest post, and discard it.
steps: Click GitHub search and type the username, press Enter
Open the top repo and note stars and language
Open mail compose, fill To with hiring@example.com
Fill Body with followers, top repo, stars, language, latest post

opportunities.name: Person Wikipedia + Wayback snapshot note
opportunities.description: Look up a person on Wikipedia, open an archived Wayback snapshot of a given site for a given year, and save a combined note with the person's bio and the snapshot headline.
steps: Search the person on Wikipedia and read the summary
Go to the Wayback Machine and enter the site URL
Select the year and a snapshot date
Read the headline from the archived page
Open Notes and type a note combining the bio and the archived headline, press Enter
